notes: The MagicBoard now holds multiple tabs: open several device GUIs or sites at once and switch between them without reloading.
Open a device's Web GUI straight from the sidebar globe and it lands in the MagicBoard, signed in from your vault.
"Open gmail", "open youtube", a device name, or a full URL all open reliably in the MagicBoard, and pop-out links stay in the pane.
Sidebar tidied up: Catalyst Center and ISE now have their own groups, the Web GUI icon shows for every web device, and the cellular modem's duplicate interfaces collapse to one.
